violations.text: Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Cooked vegetables were placed hot in the walk-in refrigerator in covered plastic containers. Proper cooling methods to be reviewed with staff. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
The floor in the kitchen area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

Sink and surface sanitizing solution was in excess of the manufacturers required parts per million (ppm). A sink and surface sanitizing solution applied to food contact surfaces must be applied at the strength as indicated on the manufacturers' label. Solution to be diluted with water prior to using. Sanitizer bucket was diluted at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Green beans were placed hot in the walk-in refrigerator in covered plastic containers. Green beans were uncovered at the time of inspection. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

Grill line refrigerator door was observed in poor repair. Door was not sealing properly. Unit was observed elevated temperature, it used primarily for non TCS foods. Tomatoes in unit which were recently sliced was relocated to other refrigeration. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026
The floor in the kitchen area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

Gravy, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Cooling guidance document provided. Cooling methods to be reviewed with staff. Product was disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2026

Sink and surface sanitizing solution was in excess of the manufacturers required parts per million (ppm). A sink and surface sanitizing solution applied to food contact surfaces must be applied at the strength as indicated on the manufacturers' label. Solution to be diluted with water prior to using. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Gravy and cooked vegetables was placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. PIC elected disposal of product. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2026
Containers were not allowed to properly air dry. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of bio-film. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the base of the slicer have an accumulation of food debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2026
The floor in the kitchen area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2026
Several items were observed stacked before properly air drying. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/23/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the base of the slicer, gaskets of units, and inside of chicken prep unit have an accumulation of food and miscellaneous debris. Areas to be cleaned. New Violation. Correct By: 12/23/2025
The floor in the kitchen area is in poor repair. Water was observed pooling in the worn down grout. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 03/31/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the walk-in refrigerators have an accumulation of dust. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2024

The handwashing sinks in the kitchen was observed with a water temperature of 81-88 degrees Fahrenheit. A HANDWASHING SINK shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100 degrees Fahrenheit through a mixing valve or combination faucet. Person in charge notified maintenance at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2024

Cheese and other items were observed held at 48 degrees Fahrenheit in the prep unit. The prep unit was observed at 51 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per PIC, foods were in the unit under 3 hours prior to inspection. All foods moved to refrigeration to rapidly cool. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2024

The following was observed in poor repair: 1) The cookline prep unit was observed maintaining an ambient temperature of 51 degrees Fahrenheit. PIC has put in a maintenance request for repairs. Unit taken out of service at the time of inspection. Unit to not be used until it can be repaired/replaced/serviced. 2) The doors of the refrigeration prep units and freezer lowboys were observed to not be properly closing. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2024

The following was observed of non-food contact surfaces: 1) The interiors and exteriors of the refrigeration/freezer/and hot holding units were observed with an accumulation of food debris 2) The sides of the cooking equipment observed to have an accumulation of oil and food debris 3) The fan covers in the walk-in cooler was observed with an accumulation of dust New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2024

The floors and walls in the cookline/prep area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Slicer broken down and moved to warewashing area. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/14/2024

The food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils were not sanitized. The required utensil surface temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit was not achieved during the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher as evidenced by the failure of the thermolabel (temperature indicator) affixed to the surface of a utensil to turn black. Establishment to use dishwasher to wash and rinse ONLY. All equipment and utensils must be sanitized in the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 03/14/2024

Meatloaf was observed to be covered with plastic stored in plastic hotel pans that were stacked on top of one another in the walk-in cooler and the grill line. Plastic wrap was removed and foods were laid on a shallow pan in the walk-in cooler. New Violation. Correct By: 03/14/2024
The non-food contact surface of the vent above the prep area and in the walk-in cooler was observed with an accumulation of dust. New Violation. Correct By: 03/14/2024
